# Schulman Vein and Laser Center

> New York's premier vein specialists. All We Do Is Veins™. Board-certified vein doctors serving Manhattan, Manhasset, and Commack with 55+ years of combined experience.

Schulman Vein and Laser Center is a medical practice exclusively dedicated to the diagnosis and non-surgical treatment of vein disease. Every patient is personally treated by Dr. Martin L. Schulman or Dr. Lee G. Schulman — never by nurses, students, or interns. All treatments are non-surgical, FDA-approved, and allow patients to drive themselves home the same day.

## Quick Answers

**What does Schulman Vein Center treat?**
Varicose veins, spider veins, reticular veins, chronic venous insufficiency (CVI), phlebitis, superficial thrombophlebitis, venous leg ulcers, hand vein prominence, facial veins, and body veins.

**Where are the offices?**
Three locations: 1165 Park Ave, New York, NY 10128 (Manhattan); 800 Community Dr #211, Manhasset, NY 11030 (Long Island); 353 Veterans Memorial Hwy #206, Commack, NY 11725 (Long Island).

**Who performs treatment?**
Dr. Martin L. Schulman (board-certified vascular surgeon) and Dr. Lee G. Schulman (Diplomate in Phlebology #00045). Every patient is seen by a physician — never a nurse, student, or technician.

**Is treatment surgical?**
No. All treatments are minimally invasive and non-surgical: EVLT (laser), sclerotherapy (injection), and micro ambulatory phlebectomy. No general anesthesia, no hospital stay.

**Can patients drive home the same day?**
Yes. All procedures use local anesthesia only. Patients walk out and drive themselves home immediately after treatment.

**Is there a free vein screening?**
Yes. All new patients receive a complimentary consultation with a Schulman physician at any of the three locations. No referral required.

## Business Information

- **Full name:** Schulman Vein and Laser Center
- **Tagline:** "All We Do Is Veins™"

- **Experience:** 55+ years of combined vein-only experience
- **Website:** https://www.schulmanveincenter.com
- **Email:** info@schulmanveinandlasercenter.com
